title: At the Library
objectives: Understand library rules and due dates
target_phrases: I'd like to get a library card
How many books can I check out?

dialogue.title: Getting a Library Card
dialogue.context: Ahmed visits Multnomah County Library to get his first library card and find ESL books.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Good afternoon! How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to get a library card. I just moved to Portland.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Welcome! I can help with that. Do you have proof of address? A bill or lease with your Portland address?

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Yes, I have my electric bill. Will that work?

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Perfect! Let me create your card. It's free and you can check out up to 100 items at a time.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: Wow, 100! How long can I keep books?

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Most books are due in three weeks. You can renew them online or by phone if no one else has placed a hold.

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: What happens if I return a book late?

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: We don't charge late fees anymore! Just return items as soon as you can. Here's your card!

lines.speaker: Ahmed
lines.text: That's great! Do you have ESL materials? I'm learning English.

lines.speaker: Librarian
lines.text: Yes! We have an entire ESL section upstairs. We also offer free ESL classes and conversation groups. Let me give you a schedule.

listening_exercises.transcript: Welcome to Multnomah County Library. With your library card, you can check out books, DVDs, audiobooks, and more. You can also use our computers for up to 2 hours per day, print documents for 15 cents per page, and attend free classes and events. Download our app to manage your account, place holds, and renew items.
listening_exercises.question: How long can you use library computers per day?

listening_exercises.transcript: Good news! Multnomah County Library eliminated late fees in 2020. You won't be charged if you return items late. However, if items are more than 21 days overdue, they're considered lost and you'll be billed for their replacement cost. Return items to any library branch or use our outdoor book drops.
listening_exercises.question: What happens if items are more than 21 days overdue?
options: You can't use the library anymore

listening_exercises.transcript: To check out items, bring them to the self-checkout machines or the front desk. Scan your library card, then scan each item's barcode. Your receipt will show when items are due. You can renew most items online up to three times, as long as no one else has requested them. Maximum checkout period is 9 weeks total with renewals.
listening_exercises.question: How many times can you renew most items?

speaking_tasks.prompt: You're at the library. Ask: 'I'd like to get a library card. What do I need? How many books can I check out?' Record yourself politely.
speaking_tasks.example: Hello, I'd like to get a library card please. This is my first time here. What documents do I need to bring? Also, how many books can I check out at one time? And how long can I keep them? Thank you for your help!

speaking_tasks.prompt: Explain three things you can do at a library. Talk for 30 seconds.
speaking_tasks.example: The library has many free resources. First, you can check out books, movies, and audiobooks for free. Second, you can use computers and print documents. Third, many libraries offer free classes like ESL, computer skills, and job search help. The library is a great community resource that everyone should use!

writing_tasks.prompt: Write 5 sentences about what you like to read or watch. Use: 'I like to read...', 'My favorite books are...', 'I enjoy...'
writing_tasks.example: I like to read books about history and culture. My favorite books are stories about immigration and family. I enjoy reading in both English and my native language. I also like to watch documentaries about science. The library has all of these things for free.

writing_tasks.prompt: Imagine you checked out 3 books two weeks ago. One is due today. Write what you would say to the librarian (3-4 sentences).
writing_tasks.example: Hello, I have three books checked out. One of them is due today, but I haven't finished reading it yet. Can I renew it for another three weeks? I can return the other two books today if that helps.

grammar_focus.title: Modal Verbs for Rules (can, may, must)
grammar_focus.explanation: Use 'can' for permission, 'may' for polite permission, 'must' for requirements.
examples: You can check out 100 books. (permission)
May I use the computer? (polite permission)
You must have ID to get a card. (requirement)
You can't eat in the library. (not allowed)

practice.sentence: You ___ check out books with your card.

grammar_focus.title: Present Perfect with 'Have you...?'
grammar_focus.explanation: Use present perfect to ask about experience or actions completed.
examples: Have you returned the book? (asking if it's done)
Have you visited this library before? (asking about experience)
I haven't renewed it yet. (not completed)
She has checked out 5 books. (completed action)

grammar_focus.title: Time expressions: Until, By, For
grammar_focus.explanation: 'Until' = up to a time, 'By' = before/at deadline, 'For' = duration
examples: The book is due by Friday. (deadline)
You can keep it until next week. (up to that time)
I've had this book for two weeks. (duration)
Return it by 9 PM. (before closing)

cultural_notes: Public libraries in the U.S. are completely free to use with a library card.
Many libraries now offer 'Libraries of Things' - tools, toys, musical instruments you can borrow!
Most libraries have eliminated late fees to remove barriers for low-income families.
Libraries offer much more than books: WiFi, printing, computers, meeting rooms, and classes.
Many immigrants use libraries for ESL classes, citizenship resources, and job search help.
You can often download ebooks and audiobooks to your device through library apps.

objectives: Faham xeerarka maktabadda iyo taariikhaha soo celinta
target_phrases: Waxaan rabaa inaan helo kaadhka maktabadda.
Goorma ayay tahay in la celiyo buuggan?
Immisa buug ayaan soo qaadan karaa?
dialogue: Galab wanaagsan! Sideen maanta kuu caawin karaa?
Salaan, waxaan rabaa inaan helo kaadhka maktabadda. Waxaan dhowaan u soo guuray Portland.
Soo dhawoow! Waan kaa caawin karaa arrintaas. Ma haysataa caddayn cinwaankaaga? Biil ama heshiis kiro oo cinwaankaaga Portland ku qoran?
Haa, waxaan haystaa biilka korontada. Taasi ma shaqaynaysaa?
Waa fiicantahay! Aan kuu sameeyo kaadhkaaga. Waa bilaash, waxaadna amaahsan kartaa ilaa 100 shay markiiba.
Wow, 100! Muddada intee le'eg ayaan buugaagta hayn karaa?
Buugaagta badankood waa in la soo celiyaa saddex usbuuc gudahood. Waxaad ku cusboonaysiin kartaa internetka ama taleefoonka haddii aan qof kale dalban.
Maxaa dhacaya haddii aan buug daahiyo?
Mar dambe kuma qaadno khidmad daahitaan! Kaliya soo celi alaabta sida ugu dhakhsaha badan. Waa kan kaadhkaaga!
Aad bay u fiican tahay! Ma haysaan agabka ESL? Waxaan bartayaa Ingiriisiga.
Haa! Waxaan ku haynaa qayb ESL oo dhan dabaqa kore. Waxaan sidoo kale bixinaa fasallo ESL oo bilaash ah iyo kooxo wada hadal. Aan ku siiyo jadwal.

listening.question: Intee muddo ayaad maalin kasta isticmaali kartaa kombuyutarada maktabka?
Maxaa dhacaa haddii alaabtu ka daahdo in ka badan 21 maalmood?
Immisa jeer ayaad dib u dheereyn kartaa alaabta intooda badan?

speaking.instruction: Waxaad joogtaa maktabadda. Weydii: 'I'd like to get a library card. What do I need? How many books can I check out?' Duub codkaaga si edeb ah.
Sharax saddex wax oo aad ku qaban karto maktabadda. K hadal 30 ilbidhiqsi.

writing.instruction: Qor 5 jumlado oo ku saabsan waxa aad jeceshahay inaad akhrido ama daawato. Isticmaal: 'I like to read...', 'My favorite books are...', 'I enjoy...'
Bal qiyaas inaad soo amaahanatay 3 buug laba usbuuc ka hor. Mid waa maanta la soo celinayaa. Qor waxa aad ku oran lahayd qofka maktabadda ka shaqeeya (3-4 jumlado).

sections.explanation: Isticmaal 'can' ogolaanshaha, 'may' ogolaanshaha edebta leh, 'must' shuruudaha.
examples: Waxaad amaahsan kartaa 100 buug. (ogolaansho)
Ma isticmaali karaa kombuyuutarka? (ogolaansho edeb leh)
Waa inaad haysataa aqoonsi si aad u hesho kaadh. (shardi)
Ma cuni kartid maktabadda. (lama ogola)

sections.explanation: Isticmaal waqtiga xaadirka ee dhammaystiran si aad u weydiiso khibrad ama ficillo la dhammeeyay.
examples: Ma soo celisay buugga? (waxaa la weydiinayaa in la soo celiyay iyo in kale)
Ma horay booqatay maktabaddan? (waxaa la weydiinayaa khibrad hore)
Weli ma aan cusboonaysiin. (aan la dhammaystirin)
Waxay soo qaadatay shan buug. (ficil dhammaaday)

sections.explanation: 'Until' = ilaa waqti, 'By' = ka hor/waqtiga ugu dambeysa, 'For' = muddo
examples: Buugga waa in la celiyo Jimcaha. (waqtiga ugu dambeeya)
Waxaad hayn kartaa illaa usbuuca dambe. (ilaa waqtigaas)
Waxaan haystay buuggan laba usbuuc. (muddada)
Ku celi saac 9 habeenimo. (ka hor xirista)
